head_commit.message:
Cursor bootstrap for #645 (#657)

* chore(cursor): bootstrap issue #645 (run 38966470660-1)

* feat(route-weights): publish per-agent capacity state in export schema v2

Emit a capacity block from capacity.py's in-process snapshot so hosted
keepalive/intake can skip shed seats, and treat state/window/observed_at
changes as publish-worthy. Keeps every v1 key; historical v1 commits stay
readable via KNOWN_SCHEMAS.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* test(route-weights): shed-pool marker flips capacity state in one export

Cover the #645 acceptance path where a live capacity.build() after a
SHED_DIR marker must shed that agent within a single export cycle.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: github-actions[bot] <github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
